name: k8s-rollout
description: A Kubernetes change rolled out safely: validate and diff against the cluster, gates, human approval of the diff, apply, wait for the rollout, verify (ready pods, no warning events, smoke checks), undo automatically on failure, and a change record.

paths.description: The manifests to apply (files or folders in the workspace)

workloads.description: The workloads to watch, e.g. "deployment/web deployment/worker" (default: the ones apply changes)

kubeconfig.description: Key Vault secret holding the kubeconfig (empty: the runtime's own)

namespace.description: Namespace (empty: the manifests' or the context's)

smoke.description: Smoke checks after the rollout (commands or URLs that must succeed)

diff.title: Validate and diff
diff.prompt:
Prepare this rollout; do not apply. Load kubernetes-operations.

Manifests: {{input.paths}}. Cluster: kubeconfig {{input.kubeconfig}}, namespace {{input.namespace}}, context {{input.context}} (empty means the default; pass only the non-empty ones to the k8s tool).
Feedback, if any: {{feedback}}

k8s validate the manifests (fix what is invalid), then k8s diff them against the cluster. diffSummary: the objects that change and how (images, replicas, env, probes), in a few lines.

fix.title: Fix the manifests
fix.prompt:
The manifest gates failed. Fix the manifests (not the gates).

{{feedback}}

approve.title: Approve the rollout
approve.message:
Apply {{input.paths}} to the cluster (kubeconfig {{input.kubeconfig}}, namespace {{input.namespace}}, context {{input.context}})?

{{state.diffSummary}}

apply.title: Apply and roll out
apply.prompt:
The human approved this rollout. k8s apply {{input.paths}} (it waits for the rollouts), then k8s rollout-status for each workload: {{input.workloads}} (or the ones apply changed). Cluster: kubeconfig {{input.kubeconfig}}, namespace {{input.namespace}}, context {{input.context}} (pass only non-empty ones).

Approved diff:
{{state.diffSummary}}

rolledOut is true only if apply succeeded and every rollout completed.

verify.title: Verify

undo.title: Undo the rollout
undo.prompt:
The rollout is not healthy. k8s rollout-undo every workload it changed ({{input.workloads}} or the ones in: {{state.apply}}), then rollout-status and get to confirm the previous version runs healthy again. Cluster: kubeconfig {{input.kubeconfig}}, namespace {{input.namespace}}, context {{input.context}}.

Why: {{state.verify}}

record.title: Change record

failed.title: Not rolled out (or undone): see the change record
